key_concepts: Pulse rate can be measured at rest and after exercise
The heart is a muscular organ about fist-sized located in the chest
The heart has four chambers: right atrium, right ventricle, left atrium, and left ventricl
Blood flows from the right atrium to the right ventricle to the lungs
Oxygen-rich blood returns from the lungs to the left atrium and left ventricle
The left ventricle pumps oxygen-rich blood to the body
Arteries carry oxygen-rich blood away from the heart
Capillaries are tiny vessels where exchange with tissues occurs
Veins carry oxygen-depleted blood back to the heart
Red blood cells contain hemoglobin and carry oxygen
White blood cells defend the body against infection
